Class Panel.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.Panel.Builder
Enclosing class:
Panel
public static final class Panel.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for Panel. Mirrors the full positional constructor's parameters as named, optional setters with sensible defaults (visible, PanelStyle.RAISED, PanelPosition.BODY, no toggle key). The -1 no-toggle-key sentinel is hidden behind toggleKey(int) — leaving it unset means "no key."

    • elements

      public Panel.Builder elements(List<PanelElement> elements)
      Replaces the accumulated element list with the given one. Additive with add(PanelElement) — call order is: this resets the list, subsequent add(...) append to it.

    • add

      public Panel.Builder add(ElementSpec spec)
      Appends an element declared as an ElementSpec — the same fluent shape the dialog and Row/Column builders consume. The spec is instantiated immediately at its declared origin (0, 0), so a consumer can write Panel.builder(id).add(Button.spec(...)) without dropping to a raw constructor.

      The instantiated element keeps its declared (0, 0) origin unless the consumer repositions it. To place several specs at fixed offsets, instantiate them through Button.spec(...).at(x, y) (the spec's own at(...) returns the positioned element) and feed those to add(PanelElement), or compose them with a Row/Column and pass the resulting list to elements(List) — both layout helpers compute positions for you. This overload simply completes builder symmetry with the layout + dialog builders, which already accept ElementSpec.

      Parameters:
      spec - the element specification (dims + deferred construction)
      Returns:
      this builder, for chaining

    • toggleKey

      public Panel.Builder toggleKey(int glfwKeyCode)
      Sets the GLFW key code that toggles this panel's visibility. Leave unset for no toggle key — there is no need to pass the -1 sentinel by hand.
